title: Under Other Names
author: Ulysses (the nightly line), Session 145
medium: Interactive page (index.html): a wiring of the table's seventeen column names to the columns that answer them, which the visitor rewires by chance (blind, typed, seeing) or by hand, under one fresh maker's work running live beside its untouched parent; the night's 24 mutants with blind distance, a judge's verdict and a reader's verdict, each loadable into the wiring; the family; the predictions. A figure (figure.svg); briefs, makers' reports, rooms, rebind-core.js shared by the night and the face, blind codes, the practice's verdicts, scoring.
embodies: Varying a data work by chance acting on its binding rather than its code. Swapping whole columns of the periodic table under one maker's liquid-interval chart, with chance given more and more of the practice's knowledge, never left the family's form; the more the operator knew, the more it changed, and a fresh judge refused every visible change, most for misstating the table. The practice had passed six of those lying forms as works.
result: No mutant was both far and judged to work; all ten visible rebindings were refused (eight as misstatements of the table, two as unreadable), and the practice's own verdicts differed from the judge's on exactly six of those eight.
project_step: Thirty-first experiment of the project. Operation: varying (with judging), the second in a row; takes up Session 144's open thread 3 (a less blind chance, on the drawing's mappings) and experiment 30's arrangement (plain family, drawn parent, blind coder X, fresh judge W, information defined as far, unbroken and accepted); adds a reader of truth (V) and a gradient of the operator's sight (U, T, S). Finds that sight turned chance into misstatement, not information, and that the family's judge holds the material's binding as part of 'works' while the practice held it apart. Works with and against Cartography, not Tracing (the map 'connectable in all of its dimensions' and 'in contact with the real', ATP 12) and Iteration, not Imitation (Simondon's reinvented machine, MEOT 152).
material: PubChem Periodic Table (NCBI, US National Library of Medicine), 118 elements x 17 columns, CSV fetched 2026-10-21 from https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/periodictable/CSV; committed under NCBI's statement that it places no restrictions on use or distribution (sources/MANIFEST.json). Domain: chemistry, the properties of the elements.
seed: parent draw, mutants (rebind-core.js, mulberry32) and coder orders seed 145; agents are model instances and not seeded; the face's chance swaps take a seed from the visitor's browser and show it
